parameters.value:
import re
import json
import html
from datetime import datetime

subject = """$get_customer_folder_emails.body.value.#.subject"""
raw_body = """$get_customer_folder_emails.body.value.#.body.content"""
sender = """$get_customer_folder_emails.body.value.#.from.emailAddress.address"""
received_time = """$get_customer_folder_emails.body.value.#.receivedDateTime"""
message_id = """$get_customer_folder_emails.body.value.#.id"""
internet_message_id = """$get_customer_folder_emails.body.value.#.internetMessageId"""
web_link = """$get_customer_folder_emails.body.value.#.webLink"""

workflow_customer = """$workflow_customer"""
iris_customer_id_raw = """$iris_customer_id"""


def clean_text(value):
    if value is None:
        return ""
    value = str(value).strip()
    value = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", value)
    return value


def clean_customer_name(value):
    value = clean_text(value)
    value = value.strip(" .,:;-\n\r\t")
    return value


def to_int(value, default):
    try:
        return int(str(value).strip())
    except Exception:
        return default


def normalize_datetime(value):
    """
    Converts SOCaaS / Graph timestamps into ISO datetime accepted by IRIS.

    Examples:
      2026-05-13 09:48:36 +00:00 -> 2026-05-13T09:48:36+00:00
      2026-05-11T07:30:08Z      -> 2026-05-11T07:30:08+00:00
    """
    value = clean_text(value)

    if not value:
        return None

    if value.endswith("Z"):
        value = value[:-1] + "+00:00"

    formats = [
        "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %z",
        "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z",
    ]

    for fmt in formats:
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(value, fmt).isoformat()
        except Exception:
            pass

    try:
        return datetime.fromisoformat(value).isoformat()
    except Exception:
        return None


def html_to_text(raw_html):
    text = raw_html or ""
    text = re.sub(r"(?i)<br\s*/?>", "\n", text)
    text = re.sub(r"(?i)</(p|div|tr|td|li|h1|h2|h3|table)>", "\n", text)
    text = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", text)
    text = html.unescape(text)
    text = text.replace("\xa0", " ")

    lines = [line.strip() for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip()]
    normalized = "\n".join(lines)

    return normalized, lines


normalized_text, lines = html_to_text(raw_body)


def value_after_label(label_regex):
    # Handles:
    # Alert Severity
    # High
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if re.fullmatch(label_regex, line, re.IGNORECASE):
            if i + 1 < len(lines):
                return clean_text(lines[i + 1])

    # Handles:
    # Alert Severity: High
    m = re.search(label_regex + r"\s*[:\-]\s*(.+)", normalized_text, re.IGNORECASE)
    if m:
        return clean_text(m.group(1))

    return None


def extract_socaas_link(raw_html):
    m = re.search(
        r'href="([^"]*socaas\.mss\.fortinet\.com[^"]+)"',
        raw_html or "",
        re.IGNORECASE
    )
    if m:
        return html.unescape(m.group(1))
    return None


def build_alert_description(
    customer,
    alert_id,
    severity_text,
    alert_type,
    detection_time,
    affected_asset,
    socaas_link
):
    lines = [
        f"Customer: {customer or 'N/A'}",
        f"SOCaaS Alert ID: {alert_id or 'N/A'}",
        f"Severity: {severity_text or 'N/A'}",
        f"Alert Type: {alert_type or 'N/A'}",
        f"Detection Time: {detection_time or 'N/A'}",
        f"Affected Asset: {affected_asset or 'N/A'}",
    ]

    if socaas_link:
        lines.append(f"SOCaaS Link: {socaas_link}")

    return "\n".join(lines)


severity_map = {
    "critical": 6,
    "high": 5,
    "medium": 1,
    "low": 4
}

# Prefer workflow/customer folder context
customer = clean_customer_name(workflow_customer)

# Fallback: parse customer from email body
if not customer:
    customer_match = re.search(
        r"SOCaaS\s+for\s+customer\s+([A-Za-z0-9 _.-]+)",
        normalized_text,
        re.IGNORECASE
    )
    customer = clean_customer_name(customer_match.group(1)) if customer_match else "Metalogalva"

alert_customer_id = to_int(iris_customer_id_raw, 3)

alert_id = value_after_label(r"Alert\s+ID")
severity_text = value_after_label(r"Alert\s+Severity")
alert_type = value_after_label(r"Alert\s+Type")
detection_time = value_after_label(r"Detection\s+Time")
affected_asset = value_after_label(r"Affected\s+Asset")

severity_key = clean_text(severity_text).lower() if severity_text else "medium"
alert_severity_id = severity_map.get(severity_key, 1)

socaas_link = extract_socaas_link(raw_body)

alert_source_event_time = normalize_datetime(detection_time)

# Fallback to received email time if SOCaaS detection time cannot be parsed
if not alert_source_event_time:
    alert_source_event_time = normalize_datetime(received_time)

if alert_id:
    alert_source_ref = f"fortisocaas:{customer}:{alert_id}"
else:
    alert_source_ref = f"email:{internet_message_id or message_id}"

if alert_type and affected_asset:
    alert_title = f"[SOCaaS][{customer}] {alert_type} - {affected_asset}"
elif alert_type:
    alert_title = f"[SOCaaS][{customer}] {alert_type}"
else:
    alert_title = f"[SOCaaS][{customer}] {subject}"

alert_description = build_alert_description(
    customer=customer,
    alert_id=alert_id,
    severity_text=severity_key,
    alert_type=alert_type,
    detection_time=detection_time,
    affected_asset=affected_asset,
    socaas_link=socaas_link
)

output = {
    "customer": customer,
    "alert_customer_id": alert_customer_id,

    "email_subject": subject,
    "email_sender": sender,
    "email_received_time": received_time,
    "email_message_id": message_id,
    "internet_message_id": internet_message_id,
    "email_web_link": web_link,

    "socaas_alert_id": alert_id,
    "socaas_link": socaas_link,
    "severity_text": severity_key,
    "alert_severity_id": alert_severity_id,
    "alert_type": alert_type,
    "detection_time": detection_time,
    "alert_source_event_time": alert_source_event_time,
    "affected_asset": affected_asset,

    "alert_title": alert_title,
    "alert_description": alert_description,
    "alert_source": "FortiGuard SOCaaS via Email Intake",
    "alert_source_ref": alert_source_ref,
    "alert_status_id": 1,
    "alert_tags": f"socaas,email-intake,{customer.lower().replace(' ', '-')}",

    # Use this clean content for IRIS source_content too
    "alert_source_content": alert_description,

    # Keep only for debugging. Do not map this to IRIS description.
    "raw_body_text": normalized_text
}

print(json.dumps(output, ensure_ascii=False))
